title: Unit Event — Lead With Courage and Kindness — Episode2 What Makes You Happy

meta.Event Outline: Honami considers Mr. Shindo's question of what kind of music she aspires to, but finds herself feeling restless as she's unable to find an answer. Meanwhile, Mr. Shindo discusses Leo/need with the president of Solis Records.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I didn't get much sleep last night...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I tried figuring out what I want to aspire to, but things started making less and less sense the more I thought about it...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And this is going to start affecting the others if I don't find my answer soon...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning, Honami... Wait, those bags under your eyes... Are you feeling okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I just had some trouble sleeping last night...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because of what Mr. Shindo said...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I figured if something's bothering you, it'd probably be that. You seemed sort of out of it yesterday too... Again, are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm fine...
But I am getting a little anxious about not being able to find the right answer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so sorry about this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
Take as much time as you need for this. Go at your own pace.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
Tell me about the things that you like or that make you happy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, I thought it'd help, but that probably needs further explanation.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's actually how I found my answer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Remember how we did that show to thank everyone who's been supporting us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Seeing Hanano and her brother there together made me realize something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Our music brought them together and allowed them to be with someone important to them.
So, how amazing would it be if we could do that for more people...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I want to bring people together through our music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thinking about the things that make you happy, things you like or what you want to do might make the answer you're looking for easier to find.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The things that make me happy...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ichika...
I'll try keeping that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Let me know if anything else comes up. I'm always here to help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. I will.
bgm_area00001
After school
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika said she's going to be running a little late because she's on classroom duty today... But the others might already be here.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I really think you should go with something more mellow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki? Rin and KAITO are here too. What could they be doing?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My plan was to make things more fun and energetic by featuring a bunch of different instruments...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which do you think would be better, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You agree with me, right?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No fair, Rin!
We're trying to get his honest opinion!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, fine!
Alright, KAITO, tell us what you think!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Something mellow or energetic... Which is it?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: U-Um, I...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't you think you're putting too much pressure on him, you two...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? Hi, Hona!
When did you get here?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Just a second ago.
Can you tell me what this discussion is about?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. So, I decided to make a new arrangement of the song I wrote for when we battled against Saku.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A new arrangement?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We still don't have that many original songs in our catalog, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're probably gonna do more shows moving forward since we're pros now, but everyone's gonna get tired of us really fast if we keep playing the same songs over and over again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it also isn't easy for us to churn out new songs. So, I thought it'd be fun to have new arrangements of old songs we could play too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I ran into these two right after I hopped over to SEKAI, so I decided to ask them to help me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heehee. You hear that, Hona?!
I think I deserve some praise for helping her like this♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you, Rin.
You as well, KAITO. We really appreciate your help.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it seemed like something was giving you a lot of trouble. Can you tell me what...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
We were talking about the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was thinking we could make things more fun and energetic by featuring a bunch of different instruments...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, that'd make it feel like a completely different song! The calm and gentle vibe is what makes this song so great!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Saki, this song was about understanding a person's loneliness, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I get what you're saying, Rin!
But since we're going through the trouble of coming up with a new arrangement for it, I want to try something really out there so it's new for everyone listening...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(A new arrangement...
I don't know much about songwriting, but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What if you started by thinking about how you want people to feel after listening to this arrangement? Would that work...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You and Ichika always take that into consideration when working on songs, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What kinds of feelings are going into it, and what the audience is going to feel when they hear it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I think it's important to take those factors into consideration here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What kinds of feelings...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This may be a new arrangement for an old song, but it's still important to take the usual things into consideration. That should help you come up with the right theme for it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin's right in saying that you may want to go with something more mellow, but I also see why you'd want to feature a variety of instruments, Saki...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That being said, you should first think about the feelings which revolve around this song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, why not start by deciding what you want them to feel now compared to before? How have these feelings changed or evolved...? That should make things easier.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What I want them to feel now compared to before...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two!
I think I have a better idea of what to do now...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
If I'm gonna add anything to wanting to understand someone's loneliness...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's it...! I won't just try to understand what they're going through! I'll try to encourage them and pull them forward! I want it to be that kind of song...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow☆ That's great!
Then, let's start over again from the intro!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Phew...
We're only about halfway through, but I've got a good feeling about this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Things are going really smoothly now that you've got a solid theme.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for helping me, you guys! This is probably gonna turn out really well now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But your brain must be tired.
I bought some cookies for us, so why don't we have them together a little later?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You did?! Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: On top of the advice you just gave me, you also brought cookies...?! You really are too good for us, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, stop...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad that I could help her...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That makes me really happy...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thinking about the things that make you happy, things you like or what you want to do might make the answer you're looking for easier to find.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is that what I want to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona?
You're spacing out there. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... I think I figured it out...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You figured something out...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes.
I think I know what I want to aspire to with our music.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's great, Hona!
What do you want to...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? What's going on?
You guys look like you're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, perfect, that makes everyone!
We can all hear what Hona has to say!
